description: INTRADAY profile, regime part. It is used for the DATA gates and the VOLATILITY brake only (stale or missing candles, one 0.8% bar or 0.15% stdev of 5-minute moves): the direction comes from the opening-range setup in setup_thresholds.json. 6 candles (30 minutes) before anything is classified, so the first possible decision is 09:45. Still OUR choices, NOT validated on real market data.
